theorem capped_shift_exponent_bounds {K : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hcap : κ ≤ 1 / (2 * (K : ℝ))) :
    0 ≤ 1 - 1 / (K : ℝ) ∧ 1 - 1 / (K : ℝ) ≤ 1 ∧
      (1 + κ) * (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) ≤ 1 ∧ κ ≤ 1 := by
  have hKR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < K := by linarith
  have hKne : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hKpos
  have hinv0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (K : ℝ) := div_nonneg zero_le_one hKpos.le
  have hinv1 : (1 : ℝ) / (K : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hKpos).mpr (by linarith)
  have hmul : κ * (2 * (K : ℝ)) ≤ 1 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (K : ℝ))).mp hcap
  have hαeq : 1 - 1 / (K : ℝ) = ((K : ℝ) - 1) / (K : ℝ) := by
    field_simp [hKne] <;> ring
  have hprod : (1 + κ) * (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hαeq, ← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hKpos).mpr
    nlinarith [hmul]
  have hκ1 : κ ≤ 1 := hcap.trans
    ((div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (K : ℝ))).mpr (by linarith))
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, hprod, hκ1⟩

theorem capped_shift_root_le_seven_mul_x {K : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) {x κ : ℝ}

    (7 * x ^ (1 + κ)) ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) ≤ 7 * x := by
  have he := capped_shift_exponent_bounds hK hκ hcap
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 7) (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0 _),

    (Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 7) he.2.1)
    (Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le hx he.2.2.1)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0 _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 7)

theorem capped_shift_payment_le_constant {K : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) {x κ : ℝ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hcap : κ ≤ 1 / (2 * (K : ℝ))) :
    2 * (K : ℝ) * (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (K - 1) +
      (7 * x ^ (1 + κ)) ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) *
        (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (K - 2)) ≤
      shiftedTauLogConstant K * x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (K - 1) := by
complete_written_theorem_types.complete_written_declaration:
theorem capped_shift_payment_le_constant {K : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) {x κ : ℝ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hcap : κ ≤ 1 / (2 * (K : ℝ))) :
    2 * (K : ℝ) * (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (K - 1) +
      (7 * x ^ (1 + κ)) ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) *
        (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (K - 2)) ≤
      shiftedTauLogConstant K * x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (K - 1) := by
  let Z : ℝ := 7 * x ^ (1 + κ)
  let L : ℝ := 1 + Real.log x
  let LZ : ℝ := 1 + Real.log Z
  let W : ℝ := (7 * L) ^ (K - 1)
  have hlogs : 1 ≤ LZ ∧ LZ ≤ 7 * L := capped_shift_log_bounds hK hx hκ hcap
  have hroot : Z ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) ≤ 7 * x :=
    capped_shift_root_le_seven_mul_x hK hx hκ hcap
  have htop : LZ ^ (K - 1) ≤ W :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith [hlogs.1]) hlogs.2 _
  have hlower : LZ ^ (K - 2) ≤ W :=
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ hlogs.1 (by omega : K - 2 ≤ K - 1)).trans htop
  have hfirst : 6 * x * LZ ^ (K - 1) ≤ 6 * x * W :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htop (by linarith)
  have hsecond : Z ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) * LZ ^ (K - 2) ≤ 7 * x * W :=
    mul_le_mul hroot hlower (pow_nonneg (by linarith [hlogs.1]) _) (by linarith)
  change 2 * (K : ℝ) * (6 * x * LZ ^ (K - 1) +
    Z ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) * LZ ^ (K - 2)) ≤ shiftedTauLogConstant K * x * L ^ (K - 1)
  calc
    2 * (K : ℝ) * (6 * x * LZ ^ (K - 1) + Z ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) * LZ ^ (K - 2)) ≤
        2 * (K : ℝ) * (6 * x * W + 7 * x * W) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hfirst hsecond) (by positivity)
    _ = shiftedTauLogConstant K * x * L ^ (K - 1) := by
      dsimp [W, shiftedTauLogConstant]
      simp only [mul_pow]
      ring

theorem rpow_mul {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ (y * z) = (x ^ y) ^ z := by
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_inj, Complex.ofReal_cpow (rpow_nonneg hx _),
      Complex.ofReal_cpow hx, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.cpow_mul, Complex.ofReal_cpow hx] <;>
    simp only [(Complex.ofReal_mul _ _).symm, (Complex.ofReal_log hx).symm, Complex.ofReal_im,
      neg_lt_zero, pi_pos, le_of_lt pi_pos]

theorem mul_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) : (x * y) ^ z = x ^ z * y ^ z := by
  iterate 2 rw [Real.rpow_def_of_nonneg]; split_ifs with h_ifs <;> simp_all
  · rw [log_mul ‹_› ‹_›, add_mul, exp_add, rpow_def_of_pos (hy.lt_of_ne' ‹_›)]
  all_goals positivity

theorem log_rpow {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) : log (x ^ y) = y * log x := by
  apply exp_injective
  rw [exp_log (rpow_pos_of_pos hx y), ← exp_log hx, mul_comm, rpow_def_of_pos (exp_pos (log x)) y]

theorem one_le_rpow {x z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : 1 ≤ x ^ z := by
  rw [← one_rpow z]
  gcongr

theorem rpow_le_self_of_one_le (h₁ : 1 ≤ x) (h₂ : y ≤ 1) : x ^ y ≤ x := by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h₁ h₂

theorem log_mul (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : log (x * y) = log x + log y :=
  exp_injective <| by
    rw [exp_log_eq_abs (mul_ne_zero hx hy), exp_add, exp_log_eq_abs hx, exp_log_eq_abs hy, abs_mul]

@[bound]
theorem log_nonneg (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ log x :=
  (log_nonneg_iff (zero_lt_one.trans_le hx)).2 hx

theorem log_le_sub_one_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : log x ≤ x - 1 := by
  rw [le_sub_iff_add_le]
  convert! add_one_le_exp (log x)
  rw [exp_log hx]

@[gcongr]
lemma pow_le_pow_right₀ [ZeroLEOneClass M₀] [PosMulMono M₀] (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    a ^ m ≤ a ^ n :=
  pow_right_mono₀ ha hmn

@[mono, gcongr, bound]
theorem pow_le_pow_left₀ [PosMulMono M₀] [MulPosMono M₀]
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : ∀ n, a ^ n ≤ b ^ n
  | 0 => by simp
  | 1 => by simpa using hab
  | n + 2 => by simpa only [pow_succ']
      using mul_le_mul hab (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hab _) (pow_succ_nonneg ha _) (ha.trans hab)

      2 * (K : ℝ) * (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (K - 1) +
        (7 * x ^ (1 + κ)) ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) *
          (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (K - 2)) := by

    (∑ v ∈ (Ioc 0 ⌊6 * x⌋₊).filter (fun v => (v : ℤ) ≠ a),

          (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (K - 2)) := by
  have hI : Ioc 0 ⌊6 * x⌋₊ = Icc 1 ⌊6 * x⌋₊ := by
